# ADR-0011 Secrets generated by a compose one-shot service

Status: accepted (2026-11-12)

**Decision:** A secrets-init service writes missing secrets and a self-signed cert into the secrets volume; services mount it read-only.

**Why:** The project requires one-command docker compose up --build, so a host-side script step is not allowed.

**Consequences:** Files are 0444 on an internal-only volume. Secrets must be included in backups. Replaceable by Docker secrets or a vault later.
